specs_json.function: fully autonomous mobile robot moving GoCarts in open, human-populated areas
specs_json.navigation: lidar + camera perception, safety-rated human detection, green guidance light
specs_json.operation: lifts and tows non-automated wheeled GoCarts
specs_json.deployment: outbound dock sortation across Amazon fulfillment network
specs_json.safety: stops/slows around humans without caged zones

notes: Amazon's first fully autonomous AMR (announced 2022) safe to operate outside fenced areas alongside employees; scales cart movement at outbound dock. ~400 kg-class cart handling; exact specs unpublished.

failure_modes.name: Lidar contamination from warehouse dust
failure_modes.mitigation: scheduled sensor cleaning, contamination self-check, dock-side maintenance triggers

failure_modes.name: Lift mechanism wear under repeated 400 kg cart cycles
failure_modes.mitigation: load-cycle-based preventive maintenance, current-signature monitoring, torque calibration

failure_modes.name: Safety-field nuisance stops in high-traffic dock areas
failure_modes.mitigation: traffic-flow zoning, fleet manager path re-planning, tuned safety field profiles per zone

failure_modes.name: Drive wheel slip on wet/dusty concrete
failure_modes.mitigation: floor condition monitoring, traction-aware speed limits, wheel tread replacement schedule

failure_modes.name: Fleet-management comms loss (WiFi dead zones)
failure_modes.mitigation: warehouse RF surveys, mesh AP redundancy, autonomous safe-hold behavior on comms loss

failure_modes.name: Cart mis-engagement with damaged/non-standard GoCarts
failure_modes.mitigation: cart inspection program, engagement sensor verification, damaged-cart flagging in WMS
